transcript.content: Hello. What brings you in to see me today?
I’ve gotten so strict about what and how much I eat that I’m barely eating at all lately. It’s starting to really interfere with my work on my job sites, which is why I finally agreed to come in.
How do you feel about your current body weight or shape, and do you have an intense fear of gaining weight?

To be honest, I just see my weight as being in "job shape" so I can easily navigate tight scaffolding, and I think my family is blowing my weight loss way out of proportion. But the thought of gaining weight makes me panic, and I dread the idea of my clients noticing I look "bigger" in my work overalls. It's a really terrifying thought for me.
Could you tell me your current height and weight, and approximately how much weight you have lost recently?

I'm not really sure of my exact height and weight, or the precise amount of weight I've lost since I don't know the exact numbers. I just know that my clothes have gotten really baggy and my tool belt keeps needing extra holes punched in it to stay up.
Have you noticed any physical changes lately, such as feeling constantly cold, dizzy, or experiencing changes in your sex drive or menstrual cycle?

I've been feeling really dizzy, lightheaded, and shaky, especially when I'm up on ladders or working long hours without eating, and I even almost fainted on a job site recently. My doctor mentioned my blood pressure is low, but I honestly just think I'm exhausted from hustling so hard. I haven't really noticed or focused on things like feeling cold or changes with my period, though.
Could you try to recall when you last had your monthly period, and whether they have stopped or become very irregular recently?

I honestly haven't been keeping track of my periods lately, so I'm not really sure when my last one was. With how crazy busy my work schedule has been and all the stress of trying to get my business going, it's just not something I've paid attention to.
Since you recently saw a doctor who checked your blood pressure, did they mention if your weight is in a dangerously low range for your height, or do you recall what weight they recorded?

My doctor and my parents did express a lot of concern about my weight being too low, but I don't recall the exact number they recorded. I honestly feel like they are blowing it way out of proportion, because I just see my size as being in "job shape" to easily navigate tight spaces on my work sites.
Even if you don't know the exact numbers, would you say your current weight is extremely low and underweight, or is it still within a normal range despite your recent weight loss?

I don't think my weight is extremely low or underweight; I just see it as being in "job shape" so I can move easily around tight spaces and scaffolding. I honestly feel like everyone is blowing the situation out of proportion when I'm really just tired from working so hard. There are plenty of women my size who function just fine.
Are you currently taking any birth control pills or using other hormonal contraceptives? Also, to the best of your knowledge, have your periods stopped altogether for several months?

I'm not really sure, and I haven't really thought about how birth control or my periods relate to what's going on. With how busy I've been with work, it's just not something I've paid attention to or have tracked.
To clarify, are you currently taking any birth control pills or using other hormonal contraceptives, like an implant, patch, or injection?
No, I'm not currently taking any birth control pills or using any other hormonal contraceptives. I'm not on anything like that right now.
Even if you don't track the exact dates, can you recall if you have had a menstrual period at all in the last three months?
I honestly can't say for sure if I've had one in the last three months. I've been so stressed and completely focused on my work that I just haven't paid any attention to it.
Besides restricting your food, do you use other methods to control your weight, such as exercising excessively, making yourself throw up, or taking laxatives or diet pills?

No, I don't do any of those things like throwing up, taking laxatives, or using diet pills. My weight control is strictly about restricting how much I eat, skipping meals, and counting calories. I also don't do any extra exercise other than the demanding physical work of climbing ladders and hauling materials on my job sites, which I just see as staying in "job shape."
Do you recall buying or using any menstrual products, like pads or tampons, at any point over the last few months?
I honestly can't recall buying or using any pads or tampons recently. I haven't really thought about it, since my mind has been completely consumed by my work and trying to get my business going.
Even if you don't know your exact current weight, do you know how tall you are and what your typical weight was before you started restricting your eating?

I'm not really sure of my exact height, and I don't know what my typical weight used to be before I started restricting. I've never really kept track of those specific numbers, so I can't say for sure.
